description: Returns a user's registered public keys for X Chat encryption. Every key field is returned by default, so public_key.fields can be left out. It takes public_key, signing_public_key, identity_public_key_signature, public_key_version and juicebox_config.

id.description: Numeric user ID, not `me`. For your own keys, use the `id` from Get My User (`GET /2/users/me`).

public_key.fields.description: A comma separated list of PublicKey fields to display.
